name: skill-security-advisor
description: After planning-consent, draft a prioritized remediation plan from a security-report. Plan-only; does not edit host files.

inputs.name: planning-consent
inputs.description: True only when the user consented to remediation planning.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: remediation-plan
outputs.description: Markdown remediation plan; empty when consent is missing.

outputs.name: blocking-questions
outputs.description: Markdown list of blocking questions; empty when none.
